# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

read_data       silicon.data

# Define potential
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Replicate the system
replicate       3 3 3

# Define settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    delay 5

timestep        0.001

# Equilibration and heating
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal

fix             1 all npt temp 300 2500 2.2 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             100000

# Unfix the npt
unfix           1

# Compute diffusion
compute         msd all msd
variable        diff equal c_msd[4]/(6*step*dt)
thermo_style    custom step temp press v_diff

# Run for diffusion

run             50000

# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units           metal
timestep        1.0
atom_style      full

# Read data file
read_data       silicon.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Replicate the system
replicate       4 4 4

# Define settings
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal

# NVT equilibration
fix             1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 100.0
run             10000
unfix           1

# NPT ensemble
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 1000.0 200.0 iso 0.0 0.0 10000.0

# Run the simulation
run             50000

# Increase temperature
fix             3 all npt temp 1000.0 2500.0 200.0 iso 0.0 0.0 10000.0

# Run the simulation
run             50000

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix           2
unfix           3
